title: Shreibman family of Sokółka
summary: The Sokółka Yizkor Book lists Meir Shreibman, his wife Dabeh, and their sons Gabriel and Reuben in the memorial necrology. The same index also lists Itzkeh and Dorah Shreibman, but does not establish that they belonged to this immediate household.
editorialContent: **Immediate family supported by the source:** Meir Shreibman, Dabeh Shreibman, Gabriel Shreibman, and Reuben Shreibman. The Yizkor Book gives no individual dates or places of death. The family is memorialized among the Jewish victims associated with Sokółka, but the precise fate of each member remains undocumented.
